title: Oracle in the Fallout Throne
description: A figure wearing a metallic helmet and golden robe sits barefoot on a massive stone throne inside a decaying cinematic chamber. The figure holds a glowing green orb in one hand and a film reel in the other, surrounded by scattered film strips, clapperboards, old newspapers, and radioactive 'FALLOUT' warning signs under a single dramatic spotlight.
prompt: A mysterious oracle figure wearing a futuristic metallic helmet and flowing golden robe sits on a massive stone throne in a ruined cinematic chamber. One hand holds a glowing green orb, the other holds a film reel. Film strips, clapperboards, old newspapers and radioactive fallout signs litter the floor. Dramatic spotlight from above illuminates the scene while cracked murals and warning symbols cover the decaying walls in a surreal dystopian atmosphere.
